info.title: Codefactory Management Portal
info.description: Authenticated workflow inspection and owner-only non-secret agent configuration management. The portal calls GitHub and LangGraph service APIs and has no database access.

502.description: GitHub identity or role verification failed

get.description: Returns bounded allowlisted GitHub workflow summaries enriched with LangGraph lifecycle status and waiting state; issue content, event payloads, and failure details are never returned.

post.description: Owner-only same-origin action to requeue a workflow event in the GitHub Service.

403.description: Verified organization owner and same-origin request required

409.description: Workflow has no eligible dead event

200.description: Effective non-secret agent configuration and audit metadata

put.description: Only a signed session with a verified GitHub Organization Owner role may update configuration. Changes apply to new workflow runs.

200.description: Configuration saved with an incremented version

403.description: Verified GitHub Organization Owner role required

get.description: Owner-only view of desired GPU and CPU model metadata, with separate artifact download and deployment rollout states. Submitted URLs and hashes are not visible to ordinary organization members.

403.description: Verified GitHub Organization Owner role required

post.description: Owner-only same-origin creation of saved instance metadata. The model must already be in shared storage; this does not provision a Deployment or roll out a model.

403.description: Verified organization owner and same-origin request required

422.description: Model is unavailable or instance configuration was rejected

get.description: Owner-only list of GGUF filenames present in shared inference artifact storage.

403.description: Verified GitHub Organization Owner role required

put.description: Owner-only same-origin update of one inference instance's desired model filename.

403.description: Verified organization owner and same-origin request required

delete.description: Owner-only same-origin deactivation of a saved instance configuration. Historical references are retained; active work and deletion of the last configuration are rejected.

403.description: Verified organization owner and same-origin request required

409.description: Instance has active work or is the last active configuration

post.description: Owner-only same-origin action. Persists one global shared-storage request and returns its durable request ID; it does not change or roll out any inference instance.

403.description: Verified organization owner and same-origin request required

409.description: A shared model download is already active

422.description: Model URL, checksum, or filename was rejected

get.description: Owner-only status read. The response omits the submitted URL and SHA-256 and exposes only fixed public error messages.

403.description: Verified GitHub Organization Owner role required

get.description: Returns per-instance CPU, RAM, GPU utilization, and VRAM metrics with explicit available, stale, and unavailable states.
Lists safe summaries from LangGraph checkpoints. Raw checkpoint blobs and issue/source content are omitted.

post.description: Owner-only same-origin action. The verified session identity and proceed_without_ci decision are recorded in LangGraph checkpoint history.

403.description: Verified organization owner and same-origin request required

409.description: Execution has no unresolved no-CI state

portalSession.name: codefactory_dashboard_session
portalSession.description: Short-lived signed session issued only after active organization membership is verified; the owner claim is set only after GitHub confirms the explicit Organization Owner role.

completion_timeout_seconds.description: Existing local-model request timeout; applies to new workflow runs.

can_edit.description: True only for a session with a verified GitHub Organization Owner role.

delivery_status.description: Webhook-delivery processing state, distinct from event queue status.

status.description: Processing state of the latest normalized task event, not workflow lifecycle status.

waiting_for.description: External input or action currently blocking the task lifecycle.
